skills.name: Basic Attack: Debt Reconciliation
skills.description:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 strikes, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Special Attack: Fiscal Fist
skills.description:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Ben lifts his weapon, blocking the enemy's attack before unleashing a forward strike, dealing Physical DMG. Successfully blocking an attack enhances the power of this skill and triggers Block Counter, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Hold [Special Attack] to remain in the Blocking stance.
While in the Blocking stance, Ben gains a Shield that weakens over time.
After leaving the blocking stance, the Shield is removed and recovers over time.
The Shield cannot exceed 16% of Ben's Max HP.
Ben is invulnerable when activating Block.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while launching strikes.

skills.name: EX Special Attack: Cashflow Counter
skills.description:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Ben lifts his weapon, blocking the enemy's attacks before unleashing a forward strike, dealing Fire DMG. Successfully blocking an attack enhances the power of this skill and triggers Block Counter, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Hold [EX Special Attack] to remain in the Blocking stance.
While in the Blocking stance, Ben gains a Shield that weakens over time.
After leaving the blocking stance, the Shield is removed and recovers over time.
The Shield cannot exceed 16% of Ben's Max HP.
When this skill is activated, the Shield is restored to its maximum value.
After activating the skill, press [EX Special Attack] again to follow up with a powerful forward strike, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Ben is invulnerable when activating Block.
Ben is invulnerable while launching strikes.

skills.name: Dodge: Missing Invoice
skills.description:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Dash Attack: Incoming Expense
skills.description:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Dodge to activate:
Strikes enemies in front of him, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Dodge Counter: Accounts Settled
skills.description:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Strike enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Chain Attack: Signed and Sealed
skills.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful strike at enemies in front in a large area, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Ultimate: Complete Payback
skills.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes a powerful strike at enemies in front in a large area, dealing massive Fire DMG.
When activating the skill, additionally recover 3 Assist Points.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Quick Assist: Joint Account
skills.description:
When the active character is launched, press [Assist] to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable during the attack.

skills.name: Defensive Assist: Risk Allocation
skills.description:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Assist] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Assist Follow-Up: Don't Break Contract
skills.description:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Charges and strikes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Core Passive: Guardian
skills.description:
Ben's initial ATK increases along with his initial DEF. He gains 80% of his initial DEF as ATK.
When Ben launches a powerful follow-up strike during his EX Special Attack, all squad members gain a Shield of 30% of his DEF +550, lasting for 30s.

skills.name: Additional Ability: Contractual Agreement
skills.description:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:
While the Shield from Core Passive: Guardian is in effect, the character's CRIT Rate is increased by 16%.

mindscapes.name: Reacting Force
mindscapes.description: When successfully Blocking an enemy with Ben's Special Attack or EX Special Attack, the DMG dealt by the blocked enemy is reduced by 30% for 15s.

mindscapes.name: Offense Through Defense
mindscapes.description: When successfully triggering a Block Counter during Ben's Special Attack or EX Special Attack, inflict an additional 300% of Ben's DEF as DMG.

mindscapes.name: Agile Adaptation

mindscapes.name: Wild Spirit
